chain.title: Quenched in Sky Stone
chain.desc: Throw a Charged Certus Quartz Crystal, an iron ingot and a Sky Stone Block into water; the in-world transform returns two Sky Steel Ingots, the metal every MEGA component is built from.

chain.title: The Fourth Press
chain.desc: Inscribe an Engineering Processor Press and a Calculation Processor Press around a Singularity; AE2 gave you three presses, this is the one that unlocks everything past 256k.

chain.title: Printed Accumulation Circuit
chain.desc: Inscribe a Sky Steel Ingot under the Accumulation Processor Press to stamp the printed circuit.

chain.title: Accumulation Processor
chain.desc: Inscribe printed silicon, fluix dust and a printed accumulation circuit together; every single MEGA device downstream needs one.

chain.title: MEGA Item Cell Housing
chain.desc: Craft from Vibrant Quartz Glass, Sky Dust and Sky Steel Ingots; the housing that turns a MEGA component into a working item cell.

chain.title: One Million
chain.desc: Craft from Sky Dust, an accumulation processor, an AE2 256k Storage Component and Vibrant Quartz Glass; the ladder starts exactly where vanilla AE2 stops.

chain.title: 1M Item Cell
chain.desc: Craft the 1M component into an item cell with Vibrant Quartz Glass, Sky Dust and iron; four times the capacity of AE2's largest disk.

chain.title: Four Million
chain.desc: Feed the 1M component back through the same pattern with ender pearl dust; each tier eats the tier below it, so the ladder is genuinely cumulative.

chain.title: Sixteen Million
chain.desc: Craft from ender pearl dust, an accumulation processor, a 4M component and Vibrant Quartz Glass.

chain.title: Sixty-Four Million
chain.desc: Craft from Matter Balls, an accumulation processor, a 16M component and Vibrant Quartz Glass; Matter Balls mean the Matter Condenser is now on your critical path.

chain.title: The Last Component
chain.desc: Craft from Matter Balls, an accumulation processor, a 64M component and Vibrant Quartz Glass; the top of the storage ladder.

chain.title: 256M Item Cell
chain.desc: Assemble the top component into an item cell; a single disk that will outlast the world you built it in.

chain.title: MEGA Fluid Cell Housing
chain.desc: Craft from Vibrant Quartz Glass, Sky Dust and copper ingots; the same component ladder now applies to fluids.

chain.title: 256M Fluid Cell
chain.desc: Combine the 256M component with the fluid housing; store an ocean of lava, oil or coolant in one slot.

chain.title: Bulk Storage Component
chain.desc: Craft from Sky Dust, an AE2 Spatial Storage Component, accumulation processors, Vibrant Quartz Glass and a 1M component; it holds exactly one item type with no upper bound.

chain.title: Truly Bottomless
chain.desc: Craft the bulk component into a cell with Vibrant Quartz Glass, Sky Dust and netherite; one item type, effectively infinite quantity - the answer to a cobblegen you never want to think about again.

chain.title: ME Cell Dock
chain.desc: Craft from iron, copper and a glass cable; dock a portable or bulk cell straight onto the network without giving up a drive bay.

chain.title: Superdense Energy Cell
chain.desc: Craft from eight Dense Energy Cells around an accumulation processor; enough buffer to ride out a full crafting job on a MEGA CPU.

chain.title: Greater Energy Card
chain.desc: Craft shapelessly from an Advanced Card and a Superdense Energy Cell; it extends the battery of any portable cell or wireless terminal.

chain.title: MEGA Interface
chain.desc: Craft shapelessly from an ME Interface and an accumulation processor; nine times the stock slots of the interface it replaces.

chain.title: MEGA Pattern Provider
chain.desc: Craft shapelessly from an ME Pattern Provider and an accumulation processor; holds far more patterns per block, so one provider can feed a whole machine wall.

chain.title: MEGA Crafting Unit
chain.desc: Craft from AE2 Crafting Units, Logic Processors, smart cable and an accumulation processor; the frame block of the oversized crafting CPU.

chain.title: MEGA Co-Processing Unit
chain.desc: Craft shapelessly from a MEGA Crafting Unit and an Engineering Processor; each one runs many parallel crafting threads instead of one.

chain.title: 256M Crafting Storage
chain.desc: Craft shapelessly from a MEGA Crafting Unit and a 256M component; a crafting CPU big enough to plan a build the size of a base in a single job.

notes: The cleanest tier ladder in the AE2 ecosystem: a brand new metal (Sky Steel), a brand new inscriber press (Accumulation), and a five-rung 1M-to-256M component line where each rung physically consumes the one below it. Starts exactly where AE2's 256k cell stops. ASSUMES FROM PARENT (ae2): Charged Certus Quartz, Sky Stone Block, Sky Dust, Vibrant Quartz Glass, fluix dust, printed silicon, Logic/Calculation/Engineering Processors and their presses, Singularity, Matter Ball and the Matter Condenser, cell_component_256k, Spatial Storage Component, Dense Energy Cell, ME Chest, ME Interface, ME Pattern Provider, Crafting Unit, Storage Monitor, Advanced Card, smart and glass cable. VERIFICATION: strict model/lang intersection, 89/89 matched, no widening needed. DROPPED - cross-mod gated, all present as items but with forge:conditional recipes that never fire without a third mod installed: the 10 mana_storage_cell_* / portable_mana_cell_* ids (Botania via appbot), the 10 source_storage_cell_* / portable_source_cell_* ids plus mega_source_cell_housing (Ars Nouveau), mega_emc_interface / cable_mega_emc_interface (ProjectE via appliede), and the chemical line - chemical_storage_cell_1m-256m, portable_chemical_cell_1m-256m, mega_chemical_cell_housing, radioactive_cell_component and radioactive_chemical_cell (require Applied Mekanistics; quest those from appmek.json's ladder instead if that mod is in the pack). ALSO DROPPED: decompression_module / decompression_pattern / compression_card were left out of the spine as a side mechanic rather than a rung, and sky_steel_block as a pure 9x compression block.
